ddos.title: Volumetric / protocol DDoS classifier
ddos.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (161 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: flows_per_s
features.description: Flow records per second toward the entity in the window

features.name: bytes_per_pkt
features.description: Mean bytes per packet sent toward the destination

features.name: src_entropy_bits
features.description: Shannon entropy of the source-IP distribution (bits)

features.name: src_entropy_norm
features.description: Source-IP entropy normalised to [0,1] by log2(#sources)

features.name: flows_per_src
features.description: Mean flows per distinct source (~1 for spoofed floods)

features.name: top_src_share
features.description: Share of flows from the busiest source

features.name: syn_only_ratio
features.description: Share of TCP flows that sent SYN but never ACK (half-open)

features.name: established_ratio
features.description: Share of TCP flows with a completed, answered handshake

features.name: amp_port_ratio
features.description: Share of UDP flows whose source port is an amplification service (DNS, NTP, SSDP, memcached...)

features.name: unanswered_ratio
features.description: Share of flows with no packet from the responder

features.name: fwd_bwd_byte_ratio_log
features.description: log10 of bytes toward / bytes from the destination

features.name: slow_conns
features.description: Long-lived, very low-rate TCP connections (Slowloris signature)

features.name: slow_ratio
features.description: Share of flows that are long-lived and very low rate

features.name: dport_entropy_norm
features.description: Normalised entropy of targeted destination ports

ddos.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)

recon_scan.title: Reconnaissance / port-scan classifier
recon_scan.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (90 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: flows_per_s
features.description: Flow records per second toward the entity in the window

features.name: max_ports_per_host
features.description: Most ports probed on a single host (vertical fan-out)

features.name: max_hosts_per_port
features.description: Most hosts probed on a single port (horizontal fan-out)

features.name: failed_ratio
features.description: Share of attempts unanswered or reset

features.name: no_payload_ratio
features.description: Share of flows that carried headers only (no payload)

features.name: port_contiguity
features.description: Share of probed ports adjacent to another probed port

features.name: attempts_per_pair
features.description: Connections per distinct (host, port) - scanners probe each once, retrying apps hammer the same few

recon_scan.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)

c2_beacon.title: C2 beaconing (periodicity) classifier
c2_beacon.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (114 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: n_conns
features.description: Connections observed for the host pair

features.name: span_s
features.description: Time span covered by those connections (s)

features.name: iat_cv
features.description: Coefficient of variation of inter-arrival time (low = periodic)

features.name: iat_mad_ratio
features.description: Median absolute deviation / median of inter-arrival time (jitter)

features.name: iat_regularity
features.description: Share of inter-arrivals within +/-20% of the median

features.name: bytes_fwd_cv
features.description: Variation of bytes sent per connection (low = scripted)

features.name: bytes_bwd_cv
features.description: Variation of bytes received per connection

features.name: dst_prevalence
features.description: Distinct internal hosts that contacted this destination in the last hour (popular service vs rare C2)

features.name: dport_web
features.description: 1 if the destination port is a web/TLS port

c2_beacon.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)

dga_domain.title: DGA domain (lexical) classifier
dga_domain.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (148 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: entropy
features.description: Shannon entropy of the label's characters

features.name: bigram_score
features.description: Mean log10 character-bigram probability under an English/benign-domain model

features.name: dict_coverage
features.description: Share of the label covered by dictionary words

features.name: tld_rarity
features.description: How unusual the domain suffix is: -log10 of its share among real popular domains (0 common .. 5 unseen)

dga_domain.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)

dns_tunnel.title: DNS tunnelling classifier
dns_tunnel.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (112 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: queries
features.description: DNS queries to the base domain in 60 s

features.name: unique_ratio
features.description: Distinct query names / queries (tunnels never repeat)

features.name: mean_sub_len
features.description: Mean length of the subdomain part (encoded payload)

features.name: sub_entropy_mean
features.description: Mean character entropy of the subdomain part

features.name: txt_null_ratio
features.description: Share of TXT / NULL / CNAME / MX / SRV / ANY queries

features.name: non_addr_ratio
features.description: Share of queries that are not A / AAAA / HTTPS

dns_tunnel.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)

encrypted_malware.title: Encrypted-session malware classifier
encrypted_malware.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (104 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: byte_ratio_log
features.description: log10 of client bytes / server bytes

features.name: splt_fwd_mean
features.description: Mean client packet length over the first packets

features.name: splt_iat_mean
features.description: Mean inter-packet time over the first packets (ms)

features.name: first_fwd_len
features.description: Size of the first client packet (ClientHello)

features.name: first_bwd_len
features.description: Size of the first server packet (ServerHello/certificate)

features.name: sni_is_ip
features.description: 1 if SNI is an IP literal

features.name: sni_digit_ratio
features.description: Share of digits in the SNI

features.name: sni_tld_rarity
features.description: Suffix rarity of the SNI (same scale as tld_rarity)

features.name: ja3_prevalence
features.description: Distinct internal hosts using this JA3 in the last hour

features.name: dst_prevalence
features.description: Distinct internal hosts that contacted this destination in the last hour (popular service vs rare C2)

encrypted_malware.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)

exfiltration.title: Data exfiltration (volume asymmetry) classifier
exfiltration.algorithm: HistGradientBoostingClassifier (67 boosting iterations after early stopping, 31 leaves, class-balanced) + isotonic probability calibration fitted on 3-fold cross-validated predictions

features.name: bytes_out_mb
features.description: MB sent from the internal host to the destination in 60 s

features.name: bytes_in_mb
features.description: MB received from the destination in 60 s

features.name: dst_prevalence
features.description: Distinct internal hosts that contacted this destination in the last hour (popular service vs rare C2)

features.name: host_out_zscore
features.description: Host's outbound volume vs its own baseline (z-score)

features.name: host_baseline_mb
features.description: Host's usual outbound MB per minute (EWMA)

features.name: share_of_host_out
features.description: Share of the host's outbound bytes going to this destination

features.name: dport_class
features.description: 0 web/TLS, 1 admin/file-transfer (SSH, FTP, SMB, DB), 2 other

exfiltration.threshold_rule: attack if 1 - P(benign) >= threshold (best F1 on validation within a 0.5% false-positive budget)
